title: Per-workspace codebase indexing with manual control
author: abdulrahimpds

test_results.notes: All 11 upstream CI checks pass. check-translations passes despite missing featureNotConfiguredWarning key.

lessons: Collection name changes in storage layers need migration logic for existing users
CI translation checks may not catch referenced-but-undefined i18n keys
Dual permission layers (global + workspace) need explicit interaction design
Unrelated changes (batch size max, setting removal) should be separate PRs
